author: root

criteria.technical: Reviewed real resolver snapshot, raw-text extraction, dependency invalidation, destructive diff scope, fail-closed base/ref handling, live CLI registry extraction and receipt shape. Final delta: cycle-safe transitive dependency hashing independently tested; administrative deep metadata excluded from candidate scan. TERM_MATCHER_GAP correctly remains an observation, while missing/dead tooltip metadata remains an objective error.
criteria.regressions: Ran npm run quality:test successfully plus independent mutations: missing English metadata, dead matcher, dependency-only new objective regression, invalid trainer and broken lesson anchor. All detected.
criteria.ci: Workflow invokes mutation proof and differential gate against exact base SHA, preserves registry artifact even after failure. Branch protection unavailable; workflow success is not an enforced branch lock.
criteria.ui: Title GlossaryText plus explicit aria-label preserves the original heading accessible name. Narrow baseline update independently inspected: exactly LessonView, glossary and two Wi-Fi lesson hashes; no bank hashes changed. Code-level acceptance only; root supplies browser evidence. Final exact heading locator reviewed: PSK selected inside actual WPA2-PSK heading. Root-produced evidence.json inspected: 375px tap and 1440px hover/focus PASS. This reviewer did not independently launch the browser.
criteria.externalLinks: Optional checker classifies successful HTTP, 404/410, and unavailable/403/timeout results separately; never uses reachability as semantic PASS. Scope is explicit URL references in sources, not every source label or every URL in content.
criteria.queue: Bounded deterministic queue preserves full unresolved registry; skips only fingerprint-matching recorded FIX/REVIEW and never manufactures PASS. Independent run selected exactly 2 lesson packets with 1540 pending records.
criteria.exceptions: Final exact-ID trivial-question exemptions independently reviewed: valid whole-material receipt, author/reviewer distinction, all hashes and contextual candidate decisions, photo-identification or obvious-fact with explicit reason. Exception codes must be a nonempty unique array drawn only from MISSING_PRO and MISSING_LESSON; answer key, plain and why cannot be waived. Structural errors prevent semantic PASS even when a receipt claims PASS.
criteria.prototypeKeys: Object.hasOwn rejects inherited constructor/toString names as glossary terms or practice destinations.

limits: No whole-bank semantic PASS. Technical errors and raw candidates remain in registry.
Term candidates are observations; code/ordinary English can be false positives.
External URL HTTP reachability is not checked, only syntax.
Independent reviewer identity is recorded in JSON but cannot be authenticated by arbitrary author/reviewer strings; protected review governance is still necessary.
Exact glossary/lesson/practice relevance, full browser return paths and mobile tooltip usability require further scoped independent evidence.
Current changed Wi-Fi materials have only partial semantic evidence; differential content gate must remain FAIL until complete valid reviews exist.
Potential legitimate content deletions cannot pass current gate; a reviewed deletion policy would be a separate feature.
